psm.description: Configure session token to access full streams of purchased tracks
psm.hint: Preview path is anonymous (all users can listen to 2-minute MP3); paid login is an optional enhancement, only enabled when accessing purchased tracks. AGPL compliance: the app acts only as an HTTP proxy, no built-in signature algorithm; users bring their own credentials to access their own purchased content. Full stream endpoint URLs are covered by a multi-candidate scanning strategy across common RESTful styles; if all candidates fail, falls back to 2-minute MP3 preview.

mora.title: mora Account
mora.description: Sign in to access metadata of purchased tracks
mora.hint: mora previews are anonymous (all users can listen to AAC previews); full Hi-Res masters require purchase on mora.jp and download via the mora Downloader client. This app does not access full streams.
